items.title: 21.5.1 Halogenoalkanes aur halogenoarenes ki reactivity ka muqabla (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 21.5.1 with Quick Check 21.4 and the DDT box, printed pages 81-82.

blocks.text: Halogenoalkanes aliphatic (zanjeer wale, ring ke baghair) organic compounds hain jin mein halogen atom alkyl group se jura hota hai. Carbon aur halogen ki electronegativity mein farq ki wajah se halogen se jure carbon par juzwi musbat (δ+) charge aa jata hai aur woh electrophile ban jata hai. Yeh electrophilic carbon nucleophiles ko hamle ki dawat deta hai, aur is se reactions ka ek bara khandan banta hai jise nucleophilic substitution reactions kehte hain.

Isi carbon ke saath wale carbon par lage hydrogen par bases ka hamla reactions ki ek aur ahem qism deta hai, jise elimination reactions kehte hain. In reactions par pehle tafseel se baat ho chuki hai.

Lekin halogenoarenes mein chlorine atom ka electron pair (lone pair) aromatic ring ke saath shamil ho kar phail jata hai (delocalise ho jata hai), jaisa neeche dikhaya gaya hai. Is phailao se carbon-halogen bond mein juzwi double bond ki khasiyat (partial double-bond character) aa jati hai aur bond mazboot ho jata hai. Yani C—Cl bond ki mazbooti barh jati hai aur use torna mushkil ho jata hai. Natija yeh ke halogenoarenes kam reactive hain aur naye compounds banane (synthesis) mein kam kaam aate hain.

blocks.alt: Chlorobenzene: chhe carbons ka halqa, paanch par H aur aik par Cl. Gulabi patti carbons ke halqe par hai, aur Cl ke gird gulabi hissa Cl wale carbon par us se mil jata (overlap) hai.
blocks.caption: Chlorobenzene mein chlorine ke lone pair ki delocalisation (kitab ke PDF safha 84 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gulabi patti benzene ring ke pi electrons hain aur Cl ke gird gulabi hissa us ka lone pair. Dono C–Cl wale carbon par mil jate hain, is liye lone pair ring mein phail jata hai. Is se C–Cl bond mein juzwi double bond ki khasiyat aati hai, woh mazboot ho jata hai aur mushkil se toot'ta hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Halogenoarene banane mein iron halide ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh Lewis acid catalyst hai: X₂ se electron pair le kar use polarise karta hai aur electrophile X⁺ (saath [FeX₄]⁻) banata hai, jo phir benzene ring par hamla karta hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Chlorobenzene aam halaat mein NaOH se react nahi karta lekin chloroethane karta hai. Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Chlorobenzene mein Cl ka lone pair ring mein delocalised hai, is liye C–Cl bond mein juzwi double bond ki khasiyat hai aur woh mazboot hai; ring nucleophile ko peeche se hamla karne bhi nahi deti. Chloroethane mein C–Cl aam polar bond hai jis par OH⁻ aasani se hamla kar leta hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Kya chlorobenzene elimination kar sakta hai? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Aam halaat mein nahi: C–Cl ke saath wale carbons aromatic ring ka hissa hain, is liye HCl hata kar naya double bond banane se mustahkam ring bigar jayegi; aur mazboot C–Cl bond bhi aasani se nahi toot'ta.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Kuch halogen compounds, jaise DDT, keere maar dawaiyon (pesticides) ke taur par istemal hue. Lekin yeh mahol mein bohat der tak baqi rehte hain, is liye taraqqi yafta (developed) mulkon mein in par pabandi lagi ya inhein band kar diya gaya. DDT sasta aur machharon ke khilaf bohat kargar hai, is liye kuch taraqqi pazeer (developing) mulkon mein is ke hatne ke baad malaria se amwaat tezi se barh gayin. Is liye mashwara hai ke mahol ki hifazat ke liye is ka istemal mehdood rakha jaye.

items: Halogenoalkanes: polar C–X, δ+ carbon; substitution aur elimination dono.
Halogenoarenes: Cl ka lone pair ring mein delocalised; C–Cl mazboot; kam reactive.
Chloroethane NaOH se react karta hai; chlorobenzene aam halaat mein nahi.
